items.title: Close windows from the sidebar
items.text: Every window row and project header in the all-windows list has a ×. It closes that window, or the whole group, without asking or taking focus, and ends its sessions.

items.title: Tiles that read as buttons
items.text: Tiles on the collapsed rail get a soft glassy rim, like the panes' own edges, that fades away as the sidebar expands.

items.title: A calmer busy shimmer
items.text: A busy pane's shine sweeps at an angle over a slow, faint gradient that keeps the row outlined between sweeps, and fades in and out as work starts and stops.

items.title: Room to breathe
items.text: Rows, tiles and headers never touch any more, collapsed or expanded.

items.title: A quieter tray
items.text: An empty tray is just its drop box, with no label. In the all-windows list, stashed panes sit with each window's other panes, and the drop box appears only while you drag.

items.title: Every pane is the same glass
items.text: New splits no longer come out a shade lighter than the pane they split from.

items.title: Collapsed panes hold still
items.text: When a pane collapses onto a stack of strips, the strip beside it no longer jiggles.
